_note: Platform limits used by caption.py and the kh-* skills. Platforms change these. When something here disagrees with what the app does today, the app is right: update this file and the date. 'verify' marks a number taken from third-party guides rather than the platform's own help pages.

instagram.label: Instagram post / Reel caption
instagram.hashtag_ideal: 3 to 5 specific tags, below the fold
instagram.notes: Hashtag cap cut from 30 to 5 on 18 Dec 2025. Links in captions are dead; use the bio link or a DM keyword.

facebook.label: Facebook page post / Reel
facebook.notes: Feed shows roughly the first 2-3 lines before 'See more' (verify). Links work, but posts with links usually reach fewer people than native photos and Reels.

tiktok.label: TikTok caption
tiktok.notes: About 80-100 characters show before 'more' (verify). TikTok is a search engine for under-30s: put the words people would type in the caption and say them in the video.

threads.label: Threads post
threads.notes: 500 characters per post; one topic tag per post (verify). Conversation first: a question or an opinion travels, an ad does not.

gbp.label: Google Business Profile update
gbp.notes: Phone numbers in the text or image get posts rejected; use the Call button. Write for local search: Karachi, North Nazimabad, perfume, extrait de parfum. Add a button (Order online / Learn more).

whatsapp_status.label: WhatsApp status caption
whatsapp_status.notes: Seen only by people who saved the number. Short, personal, one link or 'reply to this status'. (Caption limit verify.)

youtube_shorts.label: YouTube Shorts title
youtube_shorts.notes: Title does the search work. Keep the keyword in the first 40 characters.
